label: scam
title: Fake FTC 'agent' with a badge number offers to recover lost money -- for a fee
sources: FTC Consumer Alerts 2025-05, 2026-06, 2026-08: fake FTC 'agents' offering paid scam recovery

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, I'm Agent Miller with the Federal Trade Commission, badge number 4471. You lost money to an online scam last year, correct?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We recovered your funds. To release them, you just pay a processing fee of $499 with gift cards today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The offer closes at the end of business. Please keep this confidential, it's an active investigation.
